evidence.detail: Extracted the observation-only corporate no-holder rolling-median alert from the old Muse branch and surfaced it in the admin vital-signs response and deterministic economic experiment report without an extra DB query. evidence.detail: Ported the keyed non-transaction money-flow primitive, receipt getter and indexes; 13 focused primitive/index tests passed. No consumer coverage or full validation is claimed. The old 55-commit branch is being extracted in verified slices.

Migrated standalone character transfer routes to keyed debit/credit legs, then removed preflight balance checks that would block replay after a landed debit. Helper crash/recovery tests passed 12/12; web route tests passed 5/5 including a depleted-sender retry; scoped lint and format passed. Other #1672 consumers and full validation remain open.

Historical extraction checkpoint: Muse ported keyed bond-sale holder/pool/payout steps with 10/10 primitive and 9/9 route tests. Supervisor review found retries could fail on depleted holder units or changed quote/FX. More importantly, merged PR #2288 already implements durable bond-sale intents with original stored settlement terms and a repair queue. This duplicate extraction was reverted in 0108ff94f2; it is not candidate coverage.

The bond-sale slice of the old #1672 branch is superseded by merged development PR #2288, which records an intent before moving units, stamps claim/pool/payout, resumes frozen terms, and exposes unfinished intents for repair. Track 1 kept development's implementation and removed the duplicate port. #1672 remains open for other standalone flows and exact-branch validation.

Read-only Muse Spark 1.3 diff audit classified all 55 source commits into seven ordered extraction slices. Bond-sale #2288, forex turn-fill #2286, and queued fund-redemption journal supersede three conflicting slices; other unique consumers remain open. The clean source worktree is retained until those slices are implemented and verified.

Removed the 100-key eviction that could permit delayed double application on hot accounts. A 150-prior-key regression verifies an old key survives and prevents a second debit/credit after receipt expiry. Focused money-flow tests passed 21/21; document-size monitoring remains required before final validation.
